name: Teka Construction Public Company Limited
summary: Teka Construction Public Company Limited operates as a construction business in Thailand. The company provides construction services for various buildings, such as office buildings, educational buildings, shopping centers, hotels, industrial buildings, and residential buildings. It serves government and private sectors. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand. Teka Construction Public Company Limited is a subsidiary of Wanit Holding Company Limited.
